summary: Peraso Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a Common Stock Purchase Agreement with Roth Principal Investments LLC, allowing Peraso to sell up to $25 million of newly issued common stock at its discretion over 36 months. No specific price per share or premium is stated; the stock will be sold at market prices with a threshold floor. The board has not made a recommendation, and no advisor is named. This is an at-the-market equity facility, not a tender or return of capital. What to watch: frequency of draws and dilution impact on existing shareholders; the arrangement gives Peraso flexibility but may pressure the stock price.
